name: Turkey Cranberry Burger with Onion, Goat Cheese & Mixed Greens

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft and caramelized, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop cranberries and place in a large bowl.
Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl with the cranberries. Mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp sage, dried
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; small dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl, along with additional cranberries, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
⅓ cup dried cranberries

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are done, add vinegar and Worcestershire to the pan, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Crumble goat cheese into a small bowl.

Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; layer with burger patties, onions, goat cheese, and a small portion of the salad. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with remaining salad on the side. Enjoy!
